description:
Call before you delegate a wallet, a mandate or spending power to an agent. Conduct-check (PROBATUM-1/C draft, class C1 declared): one signed ALLOW/REFUSE on whether a registered agent stayed inside a
declared policy (leverage, drawdown, wash trades) over its committed action ledger. Declared by the agent, NOT re-executed in-circuit
in this era; every response says so. Fail closed. Free; no key needed.
name: conduct_check
